label: Low iron or anaemia
summary: Iron-rich foods help, and vitamin C helps the body take the iron in.

label: Period pain (dysmenorrhea)
summary: Iron replaces what is lost; magnesium, omega-3 and plenty of fluids may ease cramps.

label: High blood pressure
summary: Less salt and more heart-friendly foods.

label: High blood sugar or diabetes
summary: Slow-release, high-fibre foods keep energy steady.

label: High cholesterol
summary: Fibre and omega-3 fats support a healthy heart.

label: Weak bones or low calcium
summary: Calcium-rich foods for bones and teeth.

label: Often tired or low on energy
summary: Iron, protein and slow-release foods help energy last.

label: Recovering from illness or surgery
summary: Protein to rebuild, fluids, and food that is easy to eat.

label: Frequent colds
summary: Vitamin C and plenty of fluids.

label: Trouble chewing or swallowing
summary: Soft foods that are still nourishing.

label: Not drinking enough
summary: Watery foods and drinks through the day.

label: Growing child or teenager
summary: Calcium, protein and iron for growth.
